description: Source code for the LineChartRenderer class in the PDFsharp library, responsible for rendering line charts within the PDF graphics context.

classes.name: LineChartRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders line charts, inheriting from ColumnLikeChartRenderer, handling initialization, layout, and drawing of line charts.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific information including axes, legend, and plot area.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space for the line chart, including axes and plot area.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the entire line chart, including axes, gridlines, plot area, and legend.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes data necessary to draw each series in the line chart.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Sets up line and marker styles for each series in the chart.
